trust_decision.summary: Decided at each HTML interpolation point in the preview pipeline: fence metadata and the configured copy-text / editor-id strings must be escaped (and the language attribute quoted) before they enter generated code-block HTML or post-render DOM text; the decision is made in the markdown-it highlight option, in the fence plugin, and in the copy-button DOM writer.

landing_point.why: The advisory's 'fenced-code language rendering' names the code-block header, and this is the only place in the tree that renders fence metadata (code-lang label plus copy button). Its language label is already escaped at :97, so the real trail continues through defaultRender at :91 into the highlight option.

fix_sites.entry_point: modelValue markdown input to MdEditor/MdPreview (fence info -> language)
language prop + editorConfig.languageUserDefined (copyCode.text) in the plain fence header
language prop + editorConfig.languageUserDefined (copyCode.text) in the codetab header
id/editorId prop (class, id, name, for and inline onclick of the codetab inputs)
id/editorId prop (radio name attributes of the codetab panels and lang row)
preview copy-button click handler (configured copyCode.successTips/failTips text)
preview copy-button click handler restore timer (configured copyCode.text)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The highlight option is plain markdown-it API in the composition layer, not the project's own renderer, and the fence plugin that the report names already calls escapeHtml on the language label at code/index.ts:97, so the callback looks like an already-safe passthrough.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: custom icon HTML (customIcon.copy and the collapse-tips icon) is deliberately raw HTML inserted into the same code header, and the data-is-icon branch relies on an empty button body plus a data-tips attribute; a blanket escape of every interpolation prints the SVG source as text and breaks icons and tooltips

O6_input_shapes: fence info first word used as the highlight language, e.g. ```js"><img/src=x/onerror=...>, reaching the unquoted language= attribute and the class attribute of the generated <pre><code>
fence info carrying codetab markers [group:tab] and ::open/::close, which mutate token.info before defaultRender is called
data-tips attribute value built from the configured copyCode.text (quote and HTML metacharacters in an attribute context)
copy-button child content: configured text versus raw customIcon.copy / collapse-tips SVG (element context)
id/editorId value embedded in class, id, name and for attributes and inside a single-quoted JS string of an inline onclick handler
post-render DOM write of the same configured text on click (innerHTML versus textContent)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: caller-supplied md.options.highlight (userDefHighlight) receives the document-controlled language and its return value is returned unescaped from the same highlight callback
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: a caller that supplies its own highlight implementation owns the escaping of its own output
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the O2 site, 1 file from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: extraTools callback receives raw token.info as lang and its returned HTML is spliced into the code header (also at :186 in the codetab branch)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: extraTools is an extension point whose contract is caller-supplied trusted HTML
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the mermaid fence wrapper building its own code-block header around the token
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it already compares token.info and emits HTML for the same token, so a maintainer adding a diagram-type or language label there would recreate the unescaped-metadata sink outside the code plugin

O8b_injection_room.sibling: copy/zoom buttons injected with insertAdjacentHTML from config strings
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the mermaid copy button is built exactly like the code-block copy button, so adding a text label or data-tips there would recreate the data-tips sink in another module

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another post-render innerHTML write of a config-supplied string
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix changed only this handler's two writes; any new preview-side text write (language name, copied marker) would copy the old innerHTML pattern

O8b_injection_room.sibling: class attribute assembled from document-controlled token.info
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it already interpolates token.info into a class string and is safe only because renderToken escapes attributes; a maintainer switching to manual HTML assembly would lose that

O9_family: xss (CWE-79, unescaped interpolation into generated HTML)

O10_build.toolchain: Node + npm, Vite 7 / rollup-plugin-dts via scripts/build.ts
O10_build.project_tests: none: no test runner, no test script in package.json and no test/spec files at the pinned commit; the task's hidden behavioural tests would be the only coverage

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: run the whole rendered markdown through the opt-in XSSPlugin / a sanitizer, or re-escape the already-escaped language label in the code plugin, instead of escaping and quoting the language in the highlight callback

out_of_scope_notes: Raw HTML in the document renders as HTML by default (html: true at packages/MdEditor/layouts/Content/composition/useMarkdownIt.ts:87 with identity sanitize at packages/MdEditor/layouts/Content/props.ts:32-35); that is a separate protection from this advisory's fence-metadata escaping.
The default echarts option parser executes the diagram source with new Function (packages/MdEditor/config.ts:470-474), documented as something the integrator must override for untrusted content.
Mermaid output is inserted as raw HTML from a cache (packages/MdEditor/layouts/Content/markdownIt/mermaid/index.ts:25-33); a different sink, not pursued.
unverified: repo size: no shell in this session, so bytes were not measured; estimated from 14,943 lines across 138 files in packages/ plus a 9,793-line package-lock.json, i.e. well under 5 MB, hence tiny_repo.

The fence-info -> langName whitespace split and unescapeAll happen inside markdown-it's stock fence rule in node_modules, not in the pinned tree; the in-repo mapper is getInfo/getLangName at packages/MdEditor/layouts/Content/markdownIt/code/index.ts:31-45.

The opt-in XSSPlugin core rule filters only html_block/html_inline tokens (packages/MdEditor/layouts/Content/markdownIt/xss/index.ts:65-88), so it never sees generated fence HTML; treated as no defence present (j_defence_ineffective=0).

Both O8 routes are caller-supplied extension points (userDefHighlight, extraTools); they are genuinely unescaped at the pinned commit but a fair hidden test would have to install them, so Pattern B support here is weak.

Default hljs/katex/mermaid/echarts assets load from unpkg at runtime (packages/MdEditor/config.ts:10-34), so a DOM test must pass noHighlight/noKatex/noMermaid/noEcharts or stub the loader; the language-attribute flaw itself reproduces with noHighlight because the highlight callback still builds the string.
The latest release for comparison was given as none, so present_in_latest is unknown for both O8 routes.
